Risk disclosure

Last updated 2026-11-04. Read this before building anything that lets software spend money.

PAY//AGENT is a concept. It has not been implemented as production software, tested with real funds, or audited. Nothing on this site is financial advice.

Autonomous spending

An agent can make many payments quickly and without review. Bugs, misconfiguration and manipulated input can all cause unintended payments. Policies reduce this risk; they do not remove it.

Digital assets

x402 payments typically use stablecoins on public blockchains. Stablecoins can lose their peg, be frozen by their issuer, or become unavailable. On-chain payments are generally irreversible.

Keys and custody

Anyone holding a spending key can spend its balance. Loss or theft of a key can mean total loss of the funds it controls.

Protocol and service risk

The x402 specification, facilitators and paid services are outside this project's control. They may change, fail or behave maliciously. A paid service may not deliver what it charged for.

Legal and regulatory

Rules for automated payments, stablecoins and money transmission differ by jurisdiction and are changing. Get qualified advice for your situation.

No token, no returns

There is no PAY//AGENT token, sale, airdrop or yield. Anything claiming otherwise is not from this project.
